headline: Hitech Construction Workers Strike on Nigeria's Lagos-Calabar Highway
summary: Workers of Hitech Construction Company on Section 3B of the Lagos-Calabar Coastal Highway project went on strike over salary cuts, alleged unfair treatment, and demands to reinstate a state liaison officer.
why: The Lagos-Calabar Coastal Highway is a major federal transport project; labor actions risk delaying critical construction milestones and raising fiscal overhead.

impacts.name: Construction
impacts.why: Labor stoppages temporarily pause operations along crucial segments of Nigeria's coastal highway corridor.
